# Durable Agent Runtimes {#sec-durable-runtime}

::: {.callout-note title="Outline scaffold"}

This page makes the agreed chapter architecture renderable in Quarto. It records the chapter question, planned coverage, and intended systems outcome; full manuscript prose, figures, worked examples, fallacies, and exercises remain to be developed.

:::

## Chapter Question {.unnumbered}

_What runtime services allow a trajectory to pause, resume, branch, and recover without losing control state?_

## Planned Coverage

- Event-driven agent loops and explicit state machines
- Queues, timers, leases, and long-running workflow semantics
- Checkpointing, resumption, cancellation, and backpressure
- Scheduling heterogeneous inference and tool work
- Admission control, fairness, priorities, and deadlines

## Intended Systems Outcome

Readers should be able to design a durable execution substrate for trajectories that outlive one process or request.
